blurb: BayWater Boat Club offers unlimited access to a fleet of over 50 boats with a 10:1 member-to-boat ratio, providing stress-free boating without ownership hassles. Members receive orientation, access to boats including fishing and Gulf access boats, and can bring family, guests, and pets. Rentals are also available for visitors and occasional boaters with a separate fleet.
extraNote: No seasonal or weekday-only memberships; access all days including holidays · Three standing reservations allowed with no yearly cap; reserve up to 90 days in advance · Captain available for additional fee with advanced reservation recommended · BayWater Boat Club marina in Bonita Springs, FL
